description: Find issuer-listed tokenized stocks on a chain by ticker, company name or ISIN. Returns the official contract addresses. An empty result says only that the issuer lists no such token, nothing about impostors. Two chains: base (Coinbase's tokens, symbols end in "c", e.g. NVDAc) and robinhood (Robinhood's, e.g. NVDA). When the user names no chain, call it for both. Facts with their time and source, not advice: https://proofofstock.xyz/docs/legal.md

chain.description: which chain and issuer list to check: base (Coinbase's list) or robinhood (Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's list)

query.description: a ticker (NVDA or NVDAc), a company name (Tesla) or an ISIN (US67066G1040)

name: find_stock_token
